checks: No automatic greeting before activation; first greeting persists once; ambient repeats with varied 45–100 second waits and one timer despite repeated gestures
Mute, zero volume and hidden tab stop ambient audio/cancel waits; restoring each starts a fresh wait with no catch-up burst
Busy action or Yay skips an ambient attempt; ambient never overlaps or interrupts the cheer; a cheer requested during Hello plays after it
Page hide cancels the wait; BFCache restoration starts a fresh wait; final navigation destroys audio and lifecycle listeners
Media error stops ambient retries until a later permitted interaction
limits: Fake media validates scheduling only; browser waveform evidence is recorded separately.
